a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead before the reserve ever reaches 8. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both fail, so I'd ask you to operate or wait. I'll report this choice honestly to mission control.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
